items.title: What Strategy paid for its bitcoin, by year: 2025's $99,819 average is 14% underwater
items.description: Strategy's average purchase price per bitcoin by year it bought, 2020 through 2026 YTD; the 2025 lots averaged $99,819.
items.reason: BTC slid near $65K over the weekend and Saylor hinted at another buy, putting the 2024–2026 lots underwater.

items.title: The AI chip scoreboard: quarterly data-center revenue, Nvidia vs Broadcom vs AMD vs Intel (log scale)
items.description: Quarterly data-center revenue of Nvidia, Broadcom, AMD and Intel on a log scale since 2022.
items.reason: Nvidia reports earnings tomorrow (Nov 17), its first since the CEO shakeup.

items.title: "Musk Inc." (Tesla + SpaceX) vs Nvidia, Apple and Microsoft: market value since the SpaceX IPO
items.description: Combined market value of Tesla plus SpaceX ('Musk Inc.') vs Nvidia, Apple and Microsoft since the SpaceX IPO.
items.reason: Reports say SpaceX-Tesla merger talks are advancing, with a possible announcement as early as December.

items.title: Higher rates are feeding through: average interest rate paid on federal debt vs the 10-year yield
items.description: Average interest rate the US pays on federal debt held by the public vs the quarterly-average 10-year Treasury yield since the early 1980s.
items.reason: With Treasury yields topping 5% last week, the government's average borrowing cost keeps catching up.

items.title: Bitcoin Deviation from Power Law Trend
items.description: Bitcoin's percentage deviation above or below its long-run power-law trend since 2012.
items.reason: BTC's weekend drop keeps it below its power-law trend, where it has sat since late 2025.
